bio: Just steps from the Arco dell’Annunziata, in a quiet side street off Via Roma, Peculiare is the reflection of a young chef’s talent. The menu blends creativity and tradition, with dishes such as sole Wellington, tagliolini with sea urchins, and a refined Rossini-style filet with velvety purée and foie gras. The sober, elegant setting unfolds in an 18th-century palace, where an ancient arch tells the story of the place. The warm welcome and genuine smiles round out the experience....
